_readme: Our measured quality cells (the numbers in README.md tables). Protocol: greedy (temp 0.0), seed-1300 stratified selection for AIME, deterministic exec-grading. Hardware: single AMD Strix Halo 128GB, binaries as pinned in configs/. battery = the grader version the cell ran under. Dates ISO. GBench cells (fcb15 coding, zebra CSP) added 2026-09-19; runner vendored in gbench/. Overnight re-runs 2026-09-20: iten12 v3.1 uniform across models; aime yearsplit cells; fcb15 census for 3 more models. 27B+sharp uniform cell landed.
